synthesis.body: Round 8 of one spec sustained a stale cross-reference that had been present and reachable for at least two earlier rounds. It surfaced only because that round's brief named reference-walking as its first attack. Two consequences follow. A declining per-round finding count partly measures the brief narrowing rather than the artifact improving, so on its own it is not evidence of convergence. And a round that says nothing about an area is not evidence that the area is clean. Keep this separate from the illegitimate case: a reviewer reopening a decision the brief records as settled is not a late finding, and is refused rather than repaired.

title: A review round's findings measure where its brief pointed, not what is wrong with the artifact
